messages:
Sam H: Heads up — launching the "lighthouse" gradual wave today at 2024-07-15 15:00 UTC. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m steps. I can kick off the deploy but need smoke owners and rollback readiness checks.
Priya G: I can own the smoke checks for API and embeddings during the 5% window. Will run the quick synthetic set and watch error rate/latency.
Jordan L: I’ll do infra/rollback readiness. Confirming rollback playbook is up-to-date and I have perms to pin traffic back to blue.
Mike T: I’ll monitor logs and trace spikes. Nora, can you watch the cost/QPS dashboards?
Nora S: Yes — I’ll watch token/sec + GPU-util dashboards and set an alert if sustained >80% util.
Sam H: Thanks. Deploy sequence:
```
# 1) Start canary via deploy pipeline (sam triggers)
# 2) deploy-bot posts status and health checks run automatically
# 3) After 5m smoke OK -> increase to 20%
# 4) After 20m smoke OK -> increase to 50%
# 5) If any step fails -> rollback to previous weight and notify #oncall
```
Sam H: Smoke checklist (short):
- API /health OK across regions (curl check)
- end-to-end embedding job sample (synthetic) -> max latency < 400ms
- tail error rate < 0.5% and no new 5xx spikes
- infra metrics: GPU temp < 85C, GPU util < 85% sustained
Jordan L: Quick commands for smoke:
```bash
curl -fsS https://api.redwood.example/health || echo "unhealthy"
python infra/scripts/run_synth_test.py --prompt "lighthouse smoke" --timeout 30
```
Priya G: I’ll post the synth results in this thread after the 5% window.
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: 5% traffic -> image:redwood/lighthouse:v3.2.1 (initiated by Sam H) :rocket:
Mike T: Noted. I’ll tail traces: `kubectl logs -f svc/lighthouse --since=10m` and watch for new error traces.
Nora S: Dashboard links: https://metrics.redwood.example/d/lighthouse/token-rate (I added a temporary panel).
Sam H: Oncall: @Jordan L is primary, @Nora S is backup. If rollback is needed, Jordan executes the pipeline rollback and posts status.
Jordan L: Rollback commands (if needed):
```bash
# pin traffic back to blue
deployctl set-weight lighthouse --target blue --percent 100 --reason "rollback: smoke failed"
# scale down canary pods if we need fast fallback
kubectl scale deployment lighthouse-canary --replicas=0
```
Priya G: I’ll run the embedding synth at 15:07 UTC (5 min after start) and share numbers. If latency > 400ms or error rate > 0.5%, I’ll call for rollback.
Sam H: Runbook note: keep an 8-hour incident channel open for post-rollout regressions. If everything stable at 50% after 45m, we can schedule the final ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% -> health checks queued.
Mike T: Got alerts wired to my phone. I’ll ping here if I see any trace anomalies.
Priya G: Synth run complete: 50 samples, avg latency 210ms, p95 330ms, errors 0. Recommending continue to 20%. :thumbsup:
Sam H: Proceeding to 20% now. Triggering pipeline.
deploy-bot: Traffic increased to 20% (image:redwood/lighthouse:v3.2.1) — running post-step health checks.
Nora S: GPU util rose to 72% in us-west-2 but stable. No temp issues.
Mike T: Seeing a small spike in trace latency for a single shard — investigating, but not widespread.
Jordan L: If that shard’s errors increase >0.4% we roll back. For now hold and watch 10m.
Priya G: 20% synth after 10m: 200 samples, avg 225ms, p95 360ms, errors 0.2% — continuing to 50% if stable for next 15m.
Sam H: OK, final ramp planned in ~15m. If anyone sees red before then, call rollback. Otherwise I’ll push to 50%.
deploy-bot: Scheduled traffic ramp to 50% in 15m.
Mike T: All green from my side.
Nora S: Green.
Jordan L: Ready for rollback if needed.
Priya G: 👍
Sam H: Thanks team — will post final status after 50% stabilization check
